fields.note: First meeting following the transfer in. Mrs Voss-Brenner is still grieving and asked that we not make any changes for now. She said several times that she does not understand what is in the portfolio and that her husband handled all of it. She described herself as someone who has never taken a risk with money. Risk profiling completed as Conservative. The portfolio as transferred is not conservative.
